items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Tiny Grimes was telling me about - he was talking about the Jimmy Lunceford band

ctx.x: And so many of those bands like they're doing. It seemed like all that stuff was so powerful because Tiny Grimes was telling me about - he was talking about the Jimmy Lunceford band in the same, he was mentioning some of the same things like you were talking about. And he mentioned how, you know that they really had this stuff with the curtain open. You see these cats out there and man it was just - knock you out. Those cats would be so sharp and the music would be hitting.
